metrics.why: Share of slides with charts, stat tiles or infographics
Average words on a slide (fewer is better)
Share of slides with more than five bullets
Designed files where every slide passed the layout checks
Average time per brief (shorter is better)

method: 8 realistic business briefs (investment memo, sales review, market entry, launch plan, cost programme, hiring plan, churn analysis, capex proposal), the same flagship model (C1) at the same effort. 'On its own' is the model asked directly to write the deck in the chat; it returns slide text and Markdown tables, not a designed file. 'Wrexlyn' is the same model through Wrexlyn's design-and-review pipeline, rendered in the default dark theme. Measured automatically, not hand-scored. “pts” means percentage points: the change in a share, used where the starting share is 0%. Neither side used a figure that isn't in the brief or can't be worked out from it (0 and 0). Results vary with the brief and the engine you connect.
